<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_2107891_autofi_0.CodeAutoFixerEngine</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>CodeAutoFixerEngine</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var CodeAutoFixerEngine = Class.create();
CodeAutoFixerEngine.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
        this.companyPrefix = "BRP: ";
        this.logTable = "x_2107891_autofi_0_autofixer_log"; // Ton nom de table exact
    },

    /**
     * Orchestrateur principal appelé par le bouton
     */
    processUpdateSet: function(updateSetId) {
        if (!updateSetId) return;

        var grUpdateXML = new GlideRecord('sys_update_xml');
        grUpdateXML.addQuery('update_set', updateSetId);
        // On cible uniquement les composants de script pour éviter de toucher aux layouts
        grUpdateXML.addQuery('name', 'STARTSWITH', 'sys_script').addOrCondition('name', 'STARTSWITH', 'sys_script_include').addOrCondition('name', 'STARTSWITH', 'sys_client_script');
        grUpdateXML.query();

        while (grUpdateXML.next()) {
            var tableName = grUpdateXML.getValue('type'); 
            var targetTable = grUpdateXML.getValue('name').split('_')[0] + '_' + grUpdateXML.getValue('name').split('_')[1]; 
            var targetSysId = grUpdateXML.getValue('sys_id');

            var grSource = new GlideRecord(targetTable);
            if (grSource.get(targetSysId)) {
                this.fixNaming(grSource, updateSetId, tableName);
                this.injectHeaderComment(grSource, updateSetId, tableName);
            }
        }
        
        this.checkConflicts(updateSetId);
    },

    /**
     * Correction des conventions de nommage
     */
    fixNaming: function(grRecord, updateSetId, tableName) {
        var currentName = grRecord.getValue('name');
        
        if (currentName && !currentName.startsWith(this.companyPrefix)) {
            var newName = this.companyPrefix + currentName;
            grRecord.setValue('name', newName);
            grRecord.update(); 

            this._createLog(updateSetId, tableName + ": " + newName, "naming_corrected", currentName, newName, "Added standard company prefix.");
        }
    },

    /**
     * Injection de l'en-tête de documentation
     */
    injectHeaderComment: function(grRecord, updateSetId, tableName) {
        if (!grRecord.isValidField('script')) return;
        
        var currentScript = grRecord.getValue('script') || "";
        var recordName = grRecord.getValue('name');

        if (!currentScript.includes("/**")) {
            var today = new GlideDateTime().getLocalDate().getDisplayValue();
            var header = "/**\n" +
                         " * @name " + recordName + "\n" +
                         " * @description Automatically structured and standardized for deployment.\n" +
                         " * @date " + today + "\n" +
                         " */\n\n";

            grRecord.setValue('script', header + currentScript);
            grRecord.update();

            this._createLog(updateSetId, tableName + ": " + recordName, "header_injected", recordName, recordName, "Injected missing JSDoc header documentation block.");
        }
    },

    /**
     * Détection des conflits entre développeurs
     */
    checkConflicts: function(updateSetId) {
        var grMyUpdates = new GlideRecord('sys_update_xml');
        grMyUpdates.addQuery('update_set', updateSetId);
        grMyUpdates.query();

        while (grMyUpdates.next()) {
            var targetName = grMyUpdates.getValue('target_name');
            
            var grConflicts = new GlideRecord('sys_update_xml');
            grConflicts.addQuery('target_name', targetName);
            grConflicts.addQuery('update_set.state', 'In Progress');
            grConflicts.addQuery('update_set', '!=', updateSetId);
            grConflicts.query();

            if (grConflicts.next()) {
                var colleague = grConflicts.update_set.sys_created_by.getDisplayValue();
                var otherSet = grConflicts.update_set.name.getDisplayValue();
                
                this._createLog(
                    updateSetId, 
                    grMyUpdates.getValue('type') + ": " + targetName, 
                    "conflict_detected", 
                    targetName, 
                    targetName, 
                    "COLLISION WARNING: This element is also modified by [" + colleague + "] in the Update Set [" + otherSet + "]."
                );
            }
        }
    },

    /**
     * Insertion dans ta table de logs
     */
    _createLog: function(updateSet, element, actionType, previousName, newName, details) {
        var grLog = new GlideRecord(this.logTable);
        grLog.initialize();
        grLog.setValue('update_set', updateSet);
        grLog.setValue('corrected_element', element);
        grLog.setValue('action_type', actionType);
        grLog.setValue('previous_name', previousName);
        grLog.setValue('new_name', newName);
        grLog.setValue('details', details);
        grLog.insert();
    },

    type: 'CodeAutoFixerEngine'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-15 09:53:12</sys_created_on><sys_id>7a04165e73ca4f104f31ff604ab8b7c1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CodeAutoFixerEngine</sys_name><sys_package display_value="AutoFixer : Code Governance " source="x_2107891_autofi_0">f8f593d0738e03104f31ff604ab8b7f0</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="AutoFixer : Code Governance ">f8f593d0738e03104f31ff604ab8b7f0</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_7a04165e73ca4f104f31ff604ab8b7c1</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-15 10:06:40</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
